reported_behavior: PiP stops after lock and leaves a PiP placeholder on return.
identified_paths: Foreground nonexclusive ambient also applied to PiP, while ordinary BackgroundAudio intentionally excludes OS-owned PiP.
Quiet fullscreen exit/pagehide could call legacy native exit against a video already in PiP; CSS bookkeeping also needed to end independently of the continuing PiP video.

implementation.audio: Observe existing cross-frame BrowserTab Published PiP state; local public PiP events protect the top document immediately. Use Web playback throughout PiP and inactive/lock handoff, including temporary inline reports while hidden. Native phase is latched at willResignActive and restored on didBecomeActive; return to inline restores current saved ambient/auto. Works independently of ordinary background-audio setting. Transition category preparation does not activate/resume media.
implementation.fullscreen: PiP transitions release only own fullscreen bookkeeping/popover wrapper. Native exit/pagehide checks actual PiP mode and never calls webkitExitFullscreen against it, including delayed event ordering. Original media identity and time retained.
implementation.preserved: No forced play/pause/PiP exit/reload/player replacement, no extra background tasks/recovery loop. Existing recording/mute/pause/interruption/route handling and bounded non-PiP recovery unchanged.

verification_policy.preference: Carry forward user preference to perform device testing themselves; no long native UI automation.
verification_policy.one_time_release: Release device build, package inspection, publication and anonymous delivery only; remove temporary workflow after completion, keep normal ios.yml unchanged.

checks.audio_policy: passed in Chromium with AudioSession/PiP state mocked: both mixing inputs, active PiP, inactive/lock temporary window loss, inline restoration, cross-origin native aggregate, return while still PiP, background setting disabled/restoration, recording, pause and mute; zero play/exit calls
checks.quiet_fullscreen: passed: existing real Chromium top-layer sizing/media-clock/iframe/restoration checks plus native PiP mode event and delayed-event exit/pagehide protection (native APIs mocked); CSS PiP transition restores wrapper and real original video clock continues

limits: Actual iPhone PiP, physical lock/unlock, speaker output and supplied-site acceptance not verified here. API-state checks are not hardware proof.
PiP/lock prioritizes continuity; arbitrary other-app mixing during background/PiP remains subject to iOS/WebKit/site behavior.
No native UI or Core unit-test pass claimed for this release; the device build compiled the application and Core.
preserved: Original WebView/video identities and byte-identical build14 media region
Historical source tags and IPA assets
